Version 4 is a complete rewrite. Same presence, entirely different program around it.

### Highlights

#### 🖥️ A window instead of a console
Version 3 was a terminal program you configured with command-line flags, retyped on every launch.

- Every setting has a home on a settings screen, and the app remembers what you picked.
- It lives in the system tray while you play. Close the window and your presence keeps running.

#### ✏️ Presence text you control
Every phase has its own template, so Discord says what you want it to say.

- In client, champ select, in game and spectating, each with a live preview beside the editor.
- Leave the defaults alone and it reads the way it always did.

#### 🔄 Updates without the download
This is the last time you fetch an exe by hand.

- New versions arrive in the background and are signature-checked before anything installs.
- Restarting to apply one is your call, and you can read the changelog before you do.

### Coming from version 3

Everything version 3 put on your Discord profile is still here: summoner icons, rank emblems, KDA and creep score, champion skins including the animated ultimates, TFT companions, Arena and spectating.

- Delete your old `leagueRPC.exe`. Leaving it running alongside this means two programs fighting over the same Discord presence.
